laws.rule: Tayrona National Park, foreign non-residents: COP 81,000 low season, COP 96,500 high season, COP 43,500 at Bahía Concha (all year). Tickets sold daily at the gate; no reservations. No RBA rate for COP.
laws.heading: Tarifas de ingreso

laws.rule: Accident insurance with visitor assistance from an approved insurer is compulsory (Resolution 273 of 2024), as is the induction talk and registration before entering.

No pets, speakers, single-use plastics, drones without a permit, bottles of liquor or hallucinogens. Fires only in authorised areas; do not feed wildlife; red-flag beaches are closed; respect Indigenous families and sacred sites.
laws.heading: Condiciones de ingreso y estadía

laws.rule: Annual closures agreed with the four Sierra Nevada peoples: 1 to 15 February, 1 to 15 June, 19 October to 2 November.
Visits to Teyuna (Ciudad Perdida) must be with a certified guide booked through an authorised agency.

local-law.note: Tayrona only. Teyuna rule added 5 November 2026.

sites.name: Teyuna (Ciudad Perdida)
sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: Site in the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta reached by a multi-day walk through Indigenous territory.

access.tickets: Single park entry COP 75,000; operator tour prices vary. No RBA rate for COP.
access.permits: A certified guide is required by ICANH, national parks and Indigenous and campesino authorities; book with an authorised agency.
